description: NEXUS Agency plugin hooks for campaign validation and quality checks

hooks.prompt: Before executing this command, verify it is related to a valid NEXUS campaign operation. If the command involves campaign data processing, media plan generation, or script execution within the plugin, allow it. If it appears unrelated or potentially destructive, warn the user.

After this file modification, check: (1) If the output is a campaign artifact (media plan, governance report, attribution analysis), verify it follows NEXUS quality standards: all monetary values must sum correctly, waste + productive = gross_spend, and KPI bridges must be complete. (2) Flag any data integrity issues found.

Before finishing, check if any governance findings, campaign learnings, or anti-patterns were discovered during this session. If so, summarize them as a brief learning note the user can review for future campaigns.
